answer: Histories are stored in comet, checked in garden, and vertex exposes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 2 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 4958 identities would post 950 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
